routeDetachReattach.mechanism: Home navigation followed by browser Back keyboard command

fullElectronRestart.reason: The shared dev Electron/Host Service owned unrelated background terminals and Pi processes; stopping it would risk the user's long-lived environment. Native Pi process restart was tested separately in pi-rpc-probe.json.

conclusions: The PTY/terminal survives Renderer reload and route detach/reattach.
Pi itself knows a resumable native session UUID, model, and effective thinking level.
The installed Superset Pi extension sends none of those fields, so TerminalAgentBinding.agent_session_id remains null.
The current hook path exposes only coarse lifecycle cadence and loses toolCallId, tool name, model, thinking, and structured messages.
redactions: The harmless prompt and terminal transcript are omitted.
No environment variables, credentials, tool arguments/results, or unrelated session data are included.
